items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And I'm also related to Raymond Burke and Harold Peterson and George Peterson.

ctx.x: And I'm also related to Raymond Burke and Harold Peterson and George Peterson. My grandfather was Jules Cassard, played the violin in the French Opera. And he taught Uncle George Peterson. Taught him the violin and drum. And then he married his daughter.
And then George Peterson's son is Harold?
